Sandy Hook's typical sale price fell 23%. But buyers paid 13.3% more per square foot.

How can both be true?

Over the three months ending September, the homes that sold in 06482 were smaller. That pulls the typical price down, even though each square foot is worth more. Buyers paid about $306 a foot, up from roughly $270 a year ago.

If you own in Sandy Hook, the headline price is not your home's value. Your square footage, lot and condition are.

What does a typical Newtown home cost in property tax? About $1,145 a month.

Here's the math:
$670,000 typical home price
× 70% (the part the town taxes) = $469,000
× 2.93% town tax rate for 2026-27
= $13,742 a year

Easy rule: every $100K of home value adds about $171 a month. Homes inside the Borough of Newtown pay a small extra levy.

This is an estimate. Your real bill uses the town's assessed value, which can be lower than today's price. I check the actual tax record before any offer.
